sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Debrief with night shift regarding early morning status of the CBD.
Debrief completed, suiting up for deployment and patrols.
Welfare check on stores along Queen Street towards Britomart Square.
Welfare check Durham Street East and West alleyway, welfare check on all businesses within both vicinities, all clear.
Welfare check Vulcan Lane and businesses within the vicinity, all clear.
Welfare check BNZ Place, BNZ building entrance Shortland St, Partridge Jewelry, Pocket Park, all clear.
Welfare check Cookes, Fable, Cartier, Quest, Western Union Money Exchange, Q Convenience Store, all clear.
Welfare check Imperial Lane, building sweep around the area, all clear.
Welfare check Queens Arcade, all clear.
Arrived at check-in Commercial Bay, full sweep around the area, all clear.
Standing by to show presence to morning commuters and the public before moving along to the next checkpoint.
Dilworth Building Entrance Customs Street East
Arrived at check-in Corner of Fort Street and Fort Lane, all clear.
Welfare check Wilson Carpark Fort St, sweep around the area, all clear.
Welfare check Hoka, UGG Shoes, North Face, Taco Bell, Shortland Street Convenience Store, all clear.
Welfare check on stores along lower High Street towards Lorne St, all clear:
Welfare check through O'Connell St, all clear:
Welfare check Freyberg Sq and Chancery Square.
Management call from Hasi to make our way back to headquarters and collect flyers for the survey.

All routes and patrols on hold for the rest of the shift while we sweep from the top of Mayoral Drive down Queen Street handing out survey flyers to all stores in the CBD, while remaining vigilant for response calls and incidents.
Response call from Fun Tech during survey handouts regarding an angry customer. Assistance requested.

Arrived at the response call and spoke to both the staff and customer, heard both sides of their stories and requested they settle the disagreement with the owner when he comes into work. Customer claims his phone was never returned after handing it in to be fixed. Both parties agreed and parted ways.
Returning to handing out survey flyers.
Flyers and survey forms handed out, sitting at 45 forms accepted; some stores did not accept due to language barrier or manager not present. Heading back to headquarters to grab flyers from Hasi.
Response call from Hasi regarding an obnoxious male individual walking in public being aggressive.
Tracked him down to One NZ. Tried talking to him to calm him down but he ignored us and kept walking away. Auckland Council present. (video on file)
Busy day, no lunch break or interval break.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone.
Commencing patrols; routes on hold until response calls received. In the meantime commencing survey handouts to stores as well as welfare check-ins.
Continuing survey handouts to stores, no response calls received.
Continuing survey handouts to stores, no response calls received.
Continuing survey handouts to stores, no response calls received.
Continuing survey handouts, no response calls received.
Survey handouts still being continued, no response calls received.
Survey handouts still being continued, no issues reported and no response calls received.
No response calls received, no issues identified and no problematic issues occurred during survey handouts.
Response call from an ASG security guard regarding a suspicious male that walked into his home carpark; asked for assistance in removing him from the premises.

Arrived at 21 Hobson St Wilson Carpark, engaged with the male the ASG guard was suspicious of and did a welfare check on him; he informed us he was just relaxing and getting away from the outside world. No harm was caused and that was all that was asked of us, no issues to report. (video on file)
Heading back to HQ to charge ops phone due to low percentage.
While heading back to HQ did a welfare check: Ace Karaoke, Shakespeare, Good 2 Go Convenience — all clear, nothing to report.

Arrived at the corner of Albert St / Victoria St West, welfare check: 77 Convenience, Mr Tacos, The Fiddler, V Phix Mobiles, Skymart, Surf n Snow Backpackers — all clear, none have anything to report.
Response call from Midcity regarding a male sitting outside their store on level 1; asked for assistance in moving him along.
Arrived at response call, POI had already departed the premises. Heading back to HQ to charge ops phone.
Arrived at HQ charging ops phone.
Ops phone at 74%, recommencing survey handouts to businesses while remaining vigilant and aware of any problems / response calls.
Response call from Movenpick Hotel regarding a male sitting outside their emergency exit; asked for assistance in moving the POI along.

Arrived at Movenpick Hotel emergency exit, advised the male he had to move away from the emergency exit as requested by Movenpick staff; he complied with our orders, no issues to report. (photo on file)
Arrived back at HQ for handover to Night shift.
Afternoon shift complete, handover to Night shift. Equipment handover: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone. Auror reports have been processed.

Resuming patrol heading up Queen St. (video on file)

High St complete, no issues. Coming up on Fort St.
Fort St all clear, no issues to report. Heading to Gore St.

Response call McDonald's Queen St requesting assistance to move a vagrant along. Heading there now.

Heading back to HQ for 30 minute break and standby for guard handover.
